issues.t: 6-speed automatic harsh shifts, limp mode or failure
issues.sym: Jerky or harsh shifts, a delay before it engages, slipping, getting stuck in one gear or no reverse, and the van going into limp mode with very little power.
issues.why: The 62TE six-speed automatic behind the gas V6 works hard in a heavy van. Wear, torque converter and pump problems and control faults lead to shift complaints, and Ram issued many service bulletins for rebuilt units, torque converters and shift concerns.
issues.next: Have the transmission codes read and the fluid level and condition checked by a shop that knows this unit. Ask about software updates first; if it is slipping or will not shift, a rebuild or replacement is usually needed.

issues.t: Diesel automated manual stuck in neutral or won't move
issues.sym: The van drops into neutral on its own, pops out of gear on the highway, shows neutral and won't select any gear, or won't move at all.
issues.why: The EcoDiesel's automated manual (M40) shifts a manual gearbox with a high-pressure hydraulic unit. Flattened O-rings on its shift solenoids, a failing hydraulic unit, a bad shift position sensor, or worn shift forks and gear dogs all cause it to give up and go to neutral.
issues.next: Find a shop that is familiar with this transmission rather than replacing the clutch first. The hydraulic unit holds very high pressure, so this is not a do-it-yourself repair. Repairing the hydraulic unit or shift forks costs far less than a new transmission.

issues.t: Oil filter housing and oil cooler leak
issues.sym: Oil spots under the front of the van, oil on top of the engine in the valley between the cylinder heads, a burning oil smell, or the oil level dropping between changes.
issues.why: The plastic oil filter housing with built-in oil cooler on the Pentastar V6 cracks or its gaskets harden, so oil and sometimes coolant seep out. Ram issued a service bulletin for leaking oil filter adapters.
issues.next: Have the leak traced before it gets worse, and watch the oil and coolant levels. Replacing the housing with the updated part and new gaskets is the usual fix.

issues.t: Overheating and coolant leaks
issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs, coolant level drops, you smell sweet coolant or see steam, and the van may lose power or shut off to protect the engine.
issues.why: Radiator leaks, cooling fan problems and other coolant leaks are among the most common engine complaints for the ProMaster, and Ram issued bulletins on radiator leaks and suspected coolant leaks.
issues.next: Stop driving if the gauge goes into the red. Have a cooling system pressure test done to find the leak, and check for open cooling fan recalls.

issues.t: Radiator fan circuit can overheat and cause a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Possible burning smell or smoke from the front of the engine bay, or a cooling fan that stops working, though a fire can start without warning.
issues.why: The electrical circuit that powers the radiator fan can overheat. Recall 25V720 covers 2018 through 2026 vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and have the free repair done. Stop and shut off the engine if you smell burning or see smoke.

issues.t: Engine cooling fan can seize and overheat (recall)
issues.sym: The cooling fan stops running, the engine or A/C may run hot, and the fan motor can overheat and smell hot.
issues.why: The fan motor can seize, which overheats it. Recall 19V818 covers gas and diesel vans.
issues.next: Have the free recall repair done. Watch the temperature gauge in traffic and on hot days.

issues.t: Power steering assist weakens or quits
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes very heavy, especially at low speed or when parking, sometimes with a steering warning on the dash.
issues.why: The ProMaster uses an electrically driven power steering pump. Ram issued a service bulletin for vans with reduced or lost steering assist from a failing pump.
issues.next: Drive carefully to a shop if steering gets heavy; it still steers but takes much more effort. Have the pump and its wiring tested, and ask the dealer about the bulletin.

issues.t: Water in steering harness can cut power steering (recall)
issues.sym: Power steering assist can drop out while driving, making the van hard to turn.
issues.why: Water can get into the power steering wiring harness and disable the assist. Recall 26V621 covers 2022 through 2026 vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the free repair done. If assist is lost, slow down and steer firmly to a safe stop.

issues.t: Stalling or sudden loss of power
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving or goes into limp mode with little power, often with the check engine light on.
issues.why: Stalling and loss of power are among the most common engine complaints for these vans. Causes include overheating protection, sensor and computer faults, and for 2015 and 2018 vans, problems covered by the ignition switch and engine computer recalls.
issues.next: Pull over safely and have the codes read. Check for open recalls and software updates, and keep a record of each event.

issues.t: Parking brake won't hold or sticks on
issues.sym: The parking brake sticks on, then later stops holding the van, so it can roll when parked on a slope.
issues.why: The rear parking brake shoes wear out and the mechanism can bind. With the diesel's automated manual, there is no way to hold the van in gear, which makes a weak parking brake more serious.
issues.next: Chock the wheels on any slope until it is fixed. Have the parking brake shoes and cables inspected and adjusted or replaced.

issues.t: Brakes squeal from new
issues.sym: Loud squealing or squeaking from the brakes, even on a new van with very few miles.
issues.why: Brake pad and rotor noise was the most common complaint on early ProMasters.
issues.next: Have the brakes checked to rule out a real problem. Cleaning and lubricating the pad contact points, or switching to a different pad, usually quiets them.

issues.t: Side door check strap cracks
issues.sym: A cracked or split metal strap that limits how far a door opens, so the door swings too far, rattles or hits the body.
issues.why: The check strap and its mount on the body side crack from repeated use. Ram issued bulletins to retrofit the strap mount and add a webbing kit on the driver door.
issues.next: Have the strap and mount inspected and repaired before the door or hinge gets damaged.

issues.t: Sliding door outside handle breaks
issues.sym: The outside handle on the sliding side door goes limp and won't open the door.
issues.why: The handle breaks where the latch cable attaches. Ram issued a bulletin on it.
issues.next: Open the door from inside for now and have the handle and cable replaced.

issues.t: Front door latch binds or won't work
issues.sym: A front door is hard to open or close, does not latch, or won't open.
issues.why: The front door latch can bind. Ram issued a service bulletin for latch binding and failure.
issues.next: Do not drive with a door that will not latch. Have the latch replaced.

issues.t: Battery drain and false charging warning
issues.sym: The battery goes dead after sitting, lights stay on after shutting off, or a battery or charging warning appears even though the charging system is fine.
issues.why: Bulletins cover battery drain from the USB port and modules staying awake, and body computer software that triggers a false charging warning.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested and ask the dealer to check for these bulletins and software updates.

issues.t: A/C low on refrigerant with no leak found
issues.sym: The air conditioning blows warm and the system is found to be low on refrigerant, but no leak shows up with dye or a sniffer.
issues.why: Ram issued a service bulletin for this condition.
issues.next: Ask the shop to follow the bulletin rather than just recharging the system again.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank or shows no camera picture when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Several recalls cover this: a cracked processor on 2019-2021 vans (25V552), radio software on 2022-2023 (24V436), security gateway software on 2022 and 2024-2025 (25V330), and a 2026 recall (26V531).
issues.next: Use mirrors and look behind you when reversing. Check your VIN for open recalls and have the free repair done.

issues.t: Van may not hold in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter shows Park, but the van can roll away.
issues.why: Debris can keep the park pawl in the 62TE transmission from fully engaging. Recall 23V301 covers it.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: Shifter cable can separate from the transmission (recall)
issues.sym: The gear selector shows a different gear than the transmission is actually in, so the van may roll or move unexpectedly.
issues.why: The shifter cable can come loose from the transmission. Recalls 20V036 and 20V582 cover gas vans, including paratransit models.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time you park and have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: Corroded wiring can shift the van into neutral (recall)
issues.sym: The transmission suddenly shifts into neutral while driving and a warning may appear.
issues.why: Water can get into a wiring connector and corrode it, cutting communication with the transmission computer (recall 16V202). A separate recall (16V529) covers poorly crimped sensor wiring on 2015 vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls and have the free repairs done.

issues.t: Transmission pump can seize (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive, warning lights, or the van coasting with no power.
issues.why: The transmission oil pump can seize and lose hydraulic pressure. Recall 16V461 covers it.
issues.next: Have the free recall inspection and repair done if it is open.

issues.t: Ignition switch can lose contact and stall (recall)
issues.sym: The engine can shut off while driving, cutting power steering, power brakes and air bags.
issues.why: The ignition switch can lose electrical contact. Recall 15V799 covers 2015 vans.
issues.next: Have the free recall repair done right away.

issues.t: Engine computer chip can fail and stall (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or won't start.
issues.why: A chip inside the powertrain control module can fail. Recall 18V524 covers 2018 vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN and have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: Accelerator pedal can stick wide open (recall)
issues.sym: The gas pedal sticks down and the van keeps accelerating after you lift your foot.
issues.why: Interference with the pedal stopper can hold it open. Recall 14V032 covers 2014 vans.
issues.next: If it happens, brake firmly and shift to neutral. Have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: Water can disable air bags and lights (recall)
issues.sym: Air bag warning light, or exterior lights that stop working.
issues.why: Water can get into wiring and corrode circuits for the air bags and lights. Recall 14V294 covers 2014 vans.
issues.next: Have the free recall repair done and get any air bag light checked promptly.

issues.t: Brake hose damaged at the factory can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Brake fluid leaking near a wheel, a soft pedal, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: A tool could damage a brake hose during assembly. Recall 14V034 covers 2014 vans.
issues.next: Do not drive with a soft brake pedal. Check the VIN and have the free repair done.

issues.t: Trailer brake lights may not work (recall)
issues.sym: When towing, the trailer's brake lights do not come on.
issues.why: Software in the trailer tow module can stop the trailer brake lights from working. Recall 16V253 covers it.
issues.next: Have someone check the trailer lights before towing, and get the free software update.

issues.t: Side door beam may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom you can see, but side crash protection may be reduced. The tire placard may also show the wrong seating capacity.
issues.why: Some vans were built without a side door impact beam. Recall 24V416 covers 2021 through 2024 vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the free inspection and repair done.

issues.t: Left taillight and turn signal can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: The left rear taillight or turn signal goes out.
issues.why: A poor wiring harness connection can cut power to the lamp. Recall 24V197 covers it.
issues.next: Check your rear lights often and have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: Stability control can shut off from a loose ground (recall)
issues.sym: Stability control and related warning lights come on, and the system may not work.
issues.why: An insecure ground connection can disable electronic stability control. Recall 24V290 covers 2021 vans.
issues.next: Drive carefully in slippery conditions and have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: EV can lose drive power from software fault (recall)
issues.sym: The electric ProMaster suddenly loses drive power while driving.
issues.why: Software may not manage motor torque correctly. Recall 25V665 covers 2024-2025 ProMaster EVs.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free software update done.

issues.t: Rear bench seat may be missing legs (recall)
issues.sym: A rear bench seat may feel loose or move.
issues.why: Some 2026 vans with a rear bench seat had only two of the four seat legs installed. Recall 26V280 covers it.
issues.next: Do not seat passengers on a loose bench. Have the free recall inspection done.
